notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the Decryptor Achievement would not trigger.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Updated the Demo to the most recent version of the game.
 Players that play the Demo and buy the game, will continue to play on the same save. (no need to start from the begining)
 Fixed a bug where Achievements earned in the Demo version would not trigger after buying the game.

notes.title: Balancing Patch 1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!  I've been listening to all your feedback and I did some balancing.

Balancing: 

 Lowering the Boss HP in 6 levels

 Lowering corruption damage in 5 levels.

 Lowering prices for 8 key-upgrades

 Increased White Clone movement speed.

Now those harder levels should not feel like hitting a wall anymore. 

Nor levels where perfect runs were needed to beat the boss.

notes.title: Demo update 0.2.0
notes.notes:
New:
Added a new enemy type (Level 2)

Added a new behavior for the green enemies

Targeting System Rewritten: Now prioritizes designated targets (e.g., green enemies and the new enemy type), similar to how the Boss is targeted.

Updated corruption level bar UI

Tweaked several upgrade levels, requirements, and costs.
Bug Fixes:
Fixed a bug that caused inconsistent currency gain on player death.

Fixed  a bug where double-drop currency values were not reflected in the end-of-level summary.

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.6
notes.notes:
New:
Fixed a bug where the game would not start on the primary monitor.

Added discord button in the main menu.

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.5
notes.notes:
New:
Increased the initial attraction radius for currencies.

Added function to pan the camera in the upgrades menu with WASD and arrows.

Tweaked the mouse panning speed of camera in the upgrades menu. It is now faster and more responsive.

There is a tutorial pop-up window now when entering the gameplay screen for the first time communicating to the player that enemies do not damage the player directly, instead the player takes corruption damage in time.

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.4
notes.notes:
New:
Added 3 more background colors to the gameplay screen.

Switched the positions for upgrade prices in the tool tip for easier visibility.
Before: Cost / Amount Owned
Now: Amount Owned / Cost
